findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: There were two packages of moldy onions stored in one of the produce containers on the main floor. The onions were pulled from the shelf by the PIC to correct the violation. Ensure that food items are in good condition and never moldy.
findings.citation_text: 3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: A floor cooler storing various cheeses was observed to have an ambient temperature of 49F (measured on inspector’s thermometer). The internal thermometer of the unit read 50F, and gradually decreased to 45F. Most of the cheeses were measured at compliant temperatures, however, the top left rack of shredded cheeses were measuring between 47F - 55F. The cheeses were pulled from the shelf and the facility will have the unit serviced soon. Ensure that time/temperature control (TCS) foods are maintained at proper cold holding temperatures of 41F or below. Will follow-up on April 20, 2026 to be sure that the unit is holding proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: A sanitizer bucket wasn’t available during food preparation in the popcorn area. Discussed with person in charge (PIC) that a sanitizer solution must be available if food prep is occurring. The facility only prepares popcorn in this particular area of the store. Ensure that sanitizer solutions are available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: There wasn't a Certified Food Protection Manager present at the start of the inspection. A CFPM arrived shortly after the start of the inspection. Ensure that there is at least one CFPM present during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment:
A sanitizer bucket wasn’t available during food preparation in the chicken room. Discussed with PIC and sani bucket was prepared and tested at 200(q). Ensure that a sani bucket is present whenever food preparation is occurring. 

sanitizer bucket wasn’t available while food preparation was occurring in the chicken room. Discussed with PIC and a sani bucket was prepared and tested at 200(q). Ensure that a sani bucket is present whenever food preparation is occurring.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
There wasn't any handwashing signs posted at any of the hand sinks at the facility. The inspector provided 5 handwashing signs to be posted at each of the 5 hand sinks. Ensure that every handsink has a poster that is visible to employees to notify them to wash hands. 

6-301.14: A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Observed the standing cooler in the broaster room to not have an inside thermometer. Discussed with PIC and hanging thermometer was provided. Ensure that a hanging thermometer is present in all coolers to properly measure air temperature of unit. 

4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a box of tooth picks on the floor and a box of plates on the floor. Ensure that single use items are protected by storing them at least 6 inches above the floor. 

4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Observed the container holding the clean serving utensils in the cabinet under the coffee maker to be soiled with food debris. Store all clean and sanitized utensils in a clean container.
750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the floor tiles in the deli area to be separating from each other causing large gaps to form in the floor trapping soil. Repair floor so it is smooth and easily cleanable. 2) Observed the floor under the cabinets in the deli to be soiled with accumulated food debris along the wall. Clean the floors.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the coffee maker spout to be soiled. Clean the coffee spout.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1220 The floor drain is pretty soiled. Routinely remove the grate and scrub the drain and the attached plumbing of the three-part sink to insure that mold and soil accumulation is not occurring. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use or any time they may have become contaminated.  The coffee maker water nozzle is soiled. Wash, rinse and sanitize after each use.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: 750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations. The waste water line from the wash sink in the deli is leaking. Repair the line so that it does not leak.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1200a Floors shall be smooth, durable, easily cleansable and maintained in good repair. The floor in the deli is made of rubberized tile sections with nubs. The tile sections are not sealed to each other and make gaps that are not easily cleansable. Repair or replace floor.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-650a There are two cutting boards within the deli island that are starting to hold mold and soil within the knife cuts on the board. When the hard plastic of the cutting board becomes so worn and used that it is no longer able to be properly cleaned, please remove from service. Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Overall, the facility is spotless. Within the island deli cabinets there is a minor accumulation of powder spills from the various sugars and coffees being held within these units. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1220 The floor drain beneath the three-part sink (and the lower portion of the attached plumbing) is black with mold. Again, floors throughout the entire facility are clean. Make sure that the floor drain and plumbign is being scrubbed as well as the floors. Mold within floor drains will quickly lead to fruit flies if not being properly and routinely cleaned. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
